mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_sq, n.notification_content_txt, n.notification_target_url, n.notification_read_yn, n.notification_created_at_dtm, u.user_nm AS sender_nm FROM tbl_notification_m n LEFT JOIN tbl_user_m u ON n.sender_user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE n.receiver_user_sq = #{receiverUserSq} AND n.notification_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY n.notification_created_at_dtm DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_notification_m WHERE receiver_user_sq = #{receiverUserSq} AND notification_read_yn = 'N' AND notification_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_notification_m ( receiver_user_sq, sender_user_sq, notification_type_cd, notification_content_txt, notification_target_url ) VALUES ( #{receiverUserSq}, #{senderUserSq}, #{notificationTypeCd}, #{notificationContentTxt}, #{notificationTargetUrl} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_notification_m SET notification_read_yn = 'Y' WHERE notification_sq = #{notificationSq}
UPDATE tbl_notification_m SET notification_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE notification_sq = #{notificationSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_notification_m ( receiver_user_sq, sender_user_sq, notification_type_cd, notification_content_txt, notification_target_url ) VALUES ( #{item.receiverSq}, #{item.senderSq}, #{item.typeCd}, #{item.content}, #{item.targetUrl} )
